cause_quote: The new Access page mapped every `limit_reached` refusal to “This claw has reached its limit for people or devices. Remove one to add another.”
user_saw: When an invitation exceeded a limit, Remote access told the owner to remove a person or device.
summary: The fix tells owners to review the error details for the applicable access limit and preserves the sanitized explanation there.
reasoning: The invitation authority already returned `limit_reached` for both invitation count and lifetime limits before the Access page was introduced. The introducing diff routed access action failures through `peopleError` and gave that shared code a single people-or-devices message, so invitation limit refusals received misleading guidance from the first version of the page.
